授業概要
こちらは大学院生のためのアカデミック・ライティングのコースです。このコースでは、アカデミック・ライティングの概要（構成、引用方法、論理的一貫性）について学びます。学生は批判的に考え、書く力を身につけます。
This is an academic writing course for graduate students. The course will give an overview of academic writing (organization structure, citation methods, and logical coherence). Students will learn how to think and write critically.
授業形態
（項目）
■ Lecture・Seminar
■ Group Work・Pair Work
■ Presentation
■ Discussion
授業形態
（内容）
Lecture & active learning style (e.g., brainstorming, having discussions, and writing activities etc.)
The course will be conducted in English.
使用する教材等
Moodle, PPT and so on
全体の教育目標
The aim of this course is for students to gain a foundational knowledge of academic writing.
個別の教育目標
1. To gain an overall understanding of the fundamentals of academic writing
2. To develop the ability to write clearly and succinctly
3. To learn and apply proper citation and avoid plagiarism
4. To expand academic vocabulary and awareness of collocations
授業計画
1. Approach to Academic Writing
2. Writing a Paragraph
3. Writing the Introduction
4. Writing the Body
5. Support, Logic and Coherence
6. Writing the Conclusion
7. Adding Citations & Avoiding Plagiarism
8. Review
キーワード
academic writing, citation, coherence, vocabulary
授業の進め方
Students will engage in in-class writing tasks, review their previous written work, and discuss best practices in academic writing.
